caption: The drawing depicts three human figures standing together under a decorative triangular structure. The figure on the left appears to be an adult with a beard, wearing a brown head covering, a red shirt, a gray sash, and a long skirt with yellow and orange vertical stripes and red circles. This figure is holding a stick in their left hand and holding the hand of the central figure with their right hand. The figure on the right is also an adult, with short dark hair, dressed in a long red dress with a green lining along the edge, and black shoes. This figure is holding the hand of the central figure with their left hand. The central figure is smaller and appears to be a child, wearing a pinkish-red gown and a crown with seven points, standing slightly in front of the two adults. The background features a decorative arch or canopy with a red top, green and yellow wavy patterns, and a border with a row of green circles. There is a triangular element outlined in red and green behind the figures. On both sides of the structure, vertical yellow columns are decorated with red wavy lines. The setting, colors, and composition give a symmetrical arrangement to the figures and the structure above them.
title: Plate 28: The Holy Family: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
